facts.text: "Dinner is darling. Sit up straight, napkin on the lap, and nothing trailing near the candles."
facts.why: Edna never says this. It is in quote marks and signed Edna Mode, so it reads as a film line. Her real lines are on the quote page.
facts.fix: I never look back, darling. It distracts from the now!

facts.text: The fancy villain dinner Bob gets with Mirage.
facts.why: Syndrome says to invite Bob to dinner, and Bob waits in a grand dining room where Mirage joins him ("He won't be dining with us").

vibe.verdict: A good family placemat with Edna, Frozone and Jack-Jack all in, though a few dish notes are invented.
missing: Honey, where is my super suit (Frozone)
Dash running across the water (Nomanisan Island)
The Parrs' first dinner table row (Bob and Helen)
Jack-Jack's powers in the nursery (the baby sitter)
Syndrome's monologue, and I'll tell you a secret (Nomanisan Island)
ideas: Swap the made up Edna note for her real never look back line.
Swap 'Crispy roast potatoes with rosemary salt' for 'No capes, no gravy boat' to use the famous Edna line.
Swap 'Mirage's Nomanisan Island steak dinner' for 'Bob's briefing breakfast on the island'.
Swap 'Strawberry milk' for 'Frozone's Where is my suit? punch' with the missing suit gag.
